description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange with effect from. 06.10.2025 to 12.10.2025
reasoning: This gazette notification establishes new rates of exchange for customs duties and other charges under the Customs Ordinance. It constitutes a regulatory framework for customs valuation and compliance requirements, falling squarely under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5) as it creates binding exchange rates for customs purposes through statutory authority.
